title: Blizzard Outside, Crackling Fireplace Inside - Howling Wind and Snow for Sleep | 8 Hours
description:
8 hours of a winter blizzard heard from inside a warm log cabin. Wind howls and gusts around the walls, fine snow ticks against the window, and a fireplace crackles beside the armchair. No music, no talking.
The sound never loops: every gust is different. The fire slowly dies down in the final minutes.

0:00:00 The storm arrives
7:45:00 The fire slowly dies down

Stormwood Cabin - Storms outside. Warmth inside.
New sessions every Monday and Thursday.

Scenes and sounds are original, created with AI tools and edited by Stormwood Cabin.
